language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue is likely at or above the $235m top of the guide, but mostly through pass-through surcharges. Bandwidth beat its own guide in Q1 (actual $208.8m against $200-203m) and landed at the top in Q2 ($219.9m against $214-220m). Q3 is the first quarter carrying full-period carrier surcharge increases: AT&T 10DLC SMS $0.0030 to $0.0035 and MMS $0.0075 to $0.0090 from 2026-04-01, and T-Mobile 10DLC $0.003 to $0.004 from 2026-01-19. Surcharge revenue already rose from about $59m in Q1 to $68m in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: revenue at the top of the guide, partly from surcharges, and the stock fell 29.3% because the beat was read as pass-through and low quality (https://www.financialcontent.com/article/stockstory-2026-7-29-why-bandwidth-band-stock-is-nosediving). Q1 2026: a 2.9% beat over the top of the guide, and the stock rose 52.1%.

findings.finding: The line that sank Q2 is gross margin quality. GAAP gross margin fell to 36% from 40% on surcharges, and FY non-GAAP EPS was trimmed to $1.71-1.79 from $1.77-1.83 for infrastructure investment. Morgan Stanley's initiation (2026-10-16, Equal-weight, $56 target) puts gross profit on incremental cloud revenue at about 68% in Q2 2026, against 82% in FY2025. Management guided non-GAAP gross margin up in Q3-Q4 to about 60% for the year (Q2: 59.4%), and its Q3 EPS guide of $0.45-0.49 implies a step-up from Q2's $0.37.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-29: gross margin down 4.1 points year on year and the FY EPS trim drove a -29.3% day despite a raised revenue guide.

findings.finding: Guidance setup. The FY cloud communications guide of $622-626m (about 11% growth) explicitly 'left out ... any future benefit related to Salesforce', and management said 'there's some conservatism in our model' (Q2 call, 2026-07-29). On 2026-09-15, after that guide, Bandwidth announced it is the first certified carrier for the global rollout of Salesforce's native Contact Center across 25+ countries 'this fall', via BYOC on Maestro. The same day it filed an investor deck (8-K 7.01) reiterating '20% revenue growth and 33% Adjusted EBITDA growth for 2026'. The FY revenue guide has been raised twice ($864-884m to $880-900m to $900-910m). Implied Q4 is about $238-248m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Raised FY guides: +52.1% in April 2026 (raise with a beat) and -29.3% in July 2026 (revenue raised, EPS trimmed, H2 cloud deceleration flagged). The guide is the line this stock trades on, in both directions.

findings.finding: HCA's Q3 2026 release (2026-10-27) puts the exchange-driven uninsured payer-mix hit at ~$400M pre-tax in Q3, against ~$400M in Q2 of which ~$75M was a Q1 catch-up (so ~$325M underlying): the headwind grew roughly 20-25% q/q; HCA same-facility ER visits +5.1% (Q2 +3.6%) while surgeries stayed negative (inpatient -1.4%, outpatient -3.7%; Q2 -2.3%/-3.4%), i.e. no commercial elective recovery. CYH's guide assumed H2 ACA impact like Q2 (~$20M/quarter at midpoint) and hoped elective surgery would recover in Q3/early Q4; read across, CYH's Q3 mix is more likely at or below the Q2 run-rate than better.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last two prints, both payer-mix/volume misses with guide cuts, traded -13.66% (2026-07-22) and -12.58% (2026-04-21) per the baseline.
